passages.text: At PoseTek, we combine innovations in smartphone computing power, computer vision, and AI to bring elite-level performance testing to every competitive soccer player looking to bring their game to the next level.
caption_phrases: At PoseTek, we combine innovations in smartphone computing power,
computer vision, and AI
to bring elite-level performance testing to every competitive soccer player
looking to bring their game to the next level.

passages.text: Using just the smartphone, our custom-made cones, and our proprietary technology, we are able to capture athletes' movements across a broad set of movements.
caption_phrases: Using just the smartphone, our custom-made cones, and our proprietary technology,
we are able to capture athletes' movements across a broad set of movements.

passages.text: Our technology captures athletes' movements with computer vision directly on the smartphone, processing them in real time.
caption_phrases: Our technology captures athletes' movements with computer vision directly on the smartphone,
processing them in real time.

passages.text: It grades their performance against the professional/D1 standard, while considering their position and where they sit on the developmental pathway.
caption_phrases: It grades their performance against the professional/D1 standard,
while considering their position and where they sit on the developmental pathway.

passages.text: A deep understanding of how the player is developing allows us to produce personalized, customizable workout plans that target the things that specific player needs to focus on.
caption_phrases: A deep understanding of how the player is developing
allows us to produce personalized, customizable workout plans
that target the things that specific player needs to focus on.

passages.text: Athletes can follow these workouts in the app, in the same way they might work with a private trainer.
caption_phrases: Athletes can follow these workouts in the app,
in the same way they might work with a private trainer.

passages.text: Our AI technology also compares your technique against the pros, finds your weaknesses, and provides the tips and cues that close the loop on performance improvement.
caption_phrases: Our AI technology also compares your technique against the pros,
finds your weaknesses,
and provides the tips and cues that close the loop on performance improvement.

passages.text: Periodic retesting and re-evaluation allow the athlete to grow with the platform.
caption_phrases: Periodic retesting and re-evaluation allow the athlete to grow with the platform.

passages.text: One system democratizes the technology and coaching assistance that only the pros used to get.
